主要内容: On June 24, 2013, Novavax, Inc. appointed Barclay A "Buck" Phillips as Chief Financial Officer and entered into an employment agreement effective from the same date. The agreement outlines a base salary of $300,000, a target performance bonus of 35% of his base salary, and stock options for 300,000 shares. It also includes confidentiality and non-competition provisions. Phillips terminates his employment for good reason, he is entitled to a lump sum payment equal to twelve months of his then effective salary.
